title: TateLedger: Public Mathematical Ledger of the Tate Conjecture, Known Cases, Implications, and Hodge Comparison
description: Standalone reference ledger (`docs/STATEMENT.md`, `docs/KNOWN_CASES.md`, `docs/IMPLICATIONS.md`, `docs/HODGE_COMPARISON.md`, `docs/NOT_THIS_HOST.md`) cataloging the exact scope of the Tate Conjecture, proven cases (Faltings for divisors on abelian varieties over number fields,Zarhin over function fields, Charles-Madapusi Pera-Maulik for K3 surfaces), implications for BSD/Mordell-Weil ranks, and structural differences from the complex Hodge Conjecture. Reference ledger cataloging literature results and open problems; explicitly does not claim a proof of the general Tate or Hodge conjectures. Copyright (c) 2026 Benjamin Stanley Frohman.
